title: Daily account hotlist + QBR prep scratch
content:
Top-of-day quick brain-dump / running todo for accounts I own (working notes, not polished).

PRIORITY HOTLIST (today)
- VelaHealth (mid-market) — Renewal target: 2026-06-15 — RISK: token spike + asked for cost breakdown yesterday.
  - Today: prepare 30/60/90 token trend chart, top-5 endpoints by spend, and suggested batching/quant config to reduce unit cost.
  - Owner: me. Need SE data: Priya to confirm KV cache recommendation. Ask: send cost delta table for +3 quant profiles (8-bit, 4-bit) by EOD.
  - Notes to include in QBR: latency p95 pre/post caching, tokens per session, top pipelines (chat vs embeddings).

- AeroFin (strategic pilot) — QBR scheduled 2026-05-07 11:00 PT (with engineering + product)
  - Prep: slide deck draft + demo plan. Focus: reliability story (fallover to cheaper model variant on spot in last 90 days).
  - Action: schedule dry-run with SE (Liam) 2026-05-05. Draft demo commands to show fallback in console:
    - api call example: curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"model":"xlarge-v1","prompt":"...","fallback_policy":"variant-cost"}'
  - Data ask: platform team to provide trace snippets for a failover incident (2026-03-28) — open ticket: CS-6721.

- NimbusRetail (support case) — embeddings mismatch reported (tickets: SUP-1184, SUP-1186)
  - Short-term: escalate embedding regression to applied-ml. Attach example vectors + sample queries.
  - Temporary mitigation: recommend reindex with namespace flag + bump cosine threshold to 0.82.
  - Owner: me to coordinate with Applied ML (Sana) + SRE (Zachary) for rollout window.

LOWER PRIORITY / FYI
- OrchardAnalytics — Renewal in Sept 2026, no immediate action but flag for QBR: show ROI via query latency improvements after batching.
- BeaconEd — waiting for legal to sign new DPA; renewals team tracking (no customer action required today).

EMAIL DRAFTS / CLIPPINGS (for fast send)
- Subject: Quick cost breakdown + suggested optimizations (VelaHealth)
  Hi Alex — following up on yesterday's spike, attaching a short table + 3 options we can pilot this week: 1) prefix caching, 2) lightweight quant profile, 3) route non-critical workloads to cheaper model variant. Ping me with a preferred time for a 20m call.

- Subject: AeroFin QBR logistics + dry-run
  Hi team — QBR on May 7 confirmed. Can we run a 30m dry-run May 5 10:00 PT? Liam can lead demo. Need one trace for failover example.

QUICK CHECKLIST (ticking as I go)
- [ ] Pull VelaHealth token usage query (SQL snippet below)
- [ ] Build cost delta table for quant profiles
- [ ] Draft AeroFin slide deck (3 slides: exec summary, reliability graph, demo steps)
- [ ] Open support handoff mail for NimbusRetail w/ embeddings example
- [ ] Confirm dry-run slot with Liam and Priya

SQL snippets / queries I use often (copy/paste)
- tokens_by_customer_last_30d:
  SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens) as tokens, avg(latency_ms) as avg_lat FROM usage.events WHERE customer_id = 'velahealth' AND timestamp >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY tokens DESC;

- cost_delta_estimate (pseudo):
  -- use percent change from baseline * model_unit_cost * tokens to estimate monthly delta

NOTES / OPEN QUESTIONS
- For VelaHealth, is there a billable-for-retroactive-adjustment policy? (billing team note: ask finance)
- NimbusRetail: need to confirm whether existing index contains mixed-encoding vectors (possible cause). Ask Applied ML for exact model hash.
- AeroFin: should I include a short runbook for on-call devs during the demo? probably yes — one-liner failover steps.

REFERENCES / LINKS I WILL ATTACH TO QBR
- QBR template: confluence:CS/QBR-playbook-v2
- Recent incident trace (AeroFin): jira/INC-20260328
- Embedding regression PR: github/infra/embeddings@PR-438

TODAY'S TIMED ITEMS
- 09:30 PT: standup (cs team) — call out VelaHealth cost ask
- 11:00 PT: sync with finance (tom) re: billing policy for retro adjustments
- 14:00 PT: NimbusRetail troubleshooting window with Applied ML (Sana)

RANDOM NOTES TO SELF
- Keep slide deck to 6 min max for execs — 2 min exec summary, 2 min metrics, 2 min ask.
- Consider a one-pager summary for renewals: top 3 wins + 1 risk + next steps (attach to renewal outreach).
- Save a copy of all charts as PNGs (easy to paste in email thread).

-- harper (quick, messy — will clean before final QBRs)
